name: final_documentary_check
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,base64
r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(r)==set(map(str,ids))
p=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text());assert len(p)==20
for row in p:
 b=base64.b64decode(row['raw_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['raw_sha256'];assert json.loads(b)['statement']==row['object']['statement']; assert hashlib.sha256(row['object']['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==row['decoded_statement_sha256']
previous='0'*64; events=[]
for n,line in enumerate(Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)):
 e=json.loads(line);assert e['seq']==n and e['previous']==previous;previous=hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest();events.append(e)
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(Path.cwd().glob('*.receipt.json')):
 d=json.loads(f.read_text());receipts.append(dict(file=f.name,exit=d['exit'],killed=d['killed'],wall_s=d['wall_s'],sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes=d['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],child_cpu_cumulative_s=d['child_cpu_cumulative_s']))
audit=dict(twenty_keys=True,provenance_verified=True,hashchain_verified=True,hashchain_tip=previous,all_completed_receipts=receipts,expected_failure='design_final_ocr.receipt.json exit1, missing tesseract; preserved',scope='Documentary integrity checks only, no mathematical execution. This check receipt and terminal seal receipt are created after this inventory; manifest covers this check receipt and precisely excludes terminal seal only.')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'DOCUMENTARY-CHECK.json'],input=json.dumps(audit,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('Documentary checks passed. Expected OCR failure retained. All other completed runner exits:',sorted(set(d['exit'] for d in receipts if d['file']!='design_final_ocr.receipt.json')))
